entries.title: Match History, Ranked Stability & Battle Fixes
changes: 🕘 MATCH HISTORY
Replaced Recent Matches in the Hub with a new MATCH HISTORY menu.
Match History now includes My Matches and Global Match History.
My Matches displays Offline and Online match history in separate sections.
Global Match History displays recent Ranked matches from all players and supports player search.
Moved Global Match History out of the Ranked menu.
When leaving a replay, you can now return to the replay list you came from or return to the main Match History menu.
⚔️ BATTLE FIXES
Fixed Marshadow's Gloomdweller affecting the wrong figures. Only Ghost-type Pokémon belonging to Marshadow's own team are now considered.
Fixed knockout-triggered status effects such as Ice Beam and Ice Punch when the user is excluded instead of sent to the P.C. Their status effect can still activate as intended.
Fixed Rhyperior's Reckless Charge preventing MP reductions from working properly.
MP-reducing effects can now correctly reduce Rhyperior's normal movement while Reckless Charge remains available as an optional movement ability.
Fixed Force Remove excluding Pokémon defeated by being surrounded. Surround knockouts now send the Pokémon to the P.C. normally.
🌐 RANKED
Improved recovery when a Ranked match gets stuck during PLAYER FOUND.
If the opponent fails to finish connecting, the matchmaking attempt will now cancel instead of leaving the player stuck indefinitely.
Improved Ranked matchmaking after restarting the game following an interrupted match.
Reduced cases where players could repeatedly fail to re-enter the Ranked queue after a connection issue.
↩️ MENU NAVIGATION
Improved Back button navigation throughout the game.
Back now returns to the previous menu instead of unnecessarily returning directly to the Account Hub.
Improved navigation between Play, Offline, Online Multiplayer, LAN, and Custom Online matches.
🖥️ WINDOW FIXES
Fixed an issue where returning through menus could cause the game window to unexpectedly leave its maximized state.
Maximized windows should now remain maximized while navigating through menus.

entries.title: Recent Fixes & Improvements
changes: This update adds new figure filtering options and includes several recent gameplay, leaderboard, and replay fixes.
🔎 FIGURE FILTERING & SORTING
Added Figure ID filtering to Team Builder, Figure Library, and Figure Collection.
You can now search directly by Figure ID using values such as 331 or #331.
Figure ID is handled separately from National Pokédex number.
Added Figure ID Low → High and Figure ID High → Low sorting options.
Pokédex number sorting remains available separately.
🏆 LEADERBOARD
Improved Full Leaderboard loading so all Ranked players can be loaded across multiple pages.
Fixed older Ranked players potentially being missing because historical Ranked games were not included in their Ranked game count.
Leaderboard columns now display WIN, LOSS, and DRAW.
Removed unnecessary decimal values from Rating and match statistics.
⚔️ BATTLE FIXES
Trickery Shift now occurs after applicable damage buffs and debuffs have been calculated, allowing players to see the correct final attack values before making their decision.
Force Remove now properly excludes a defeated figure instead of allowing knockout-triggered form changes or similar effects to bypass it.
Purple vs Purple ties no longer activate battle passives.
Fixed Mirror Coat and similar effects incorrectly activating after a Purple vs Purple draw.
Pokémon with effects that activate when knocked out during battle no longer trigger those effects when they are knocked out by unrelated field or secondary effects.
Fixed exclusion effects such as Fusion Flare and Fusion Bolt not properly excluding a Pokémon when another battle effect such as Destiny Bond was involved.
🌀 MOVE & ABILITY FIXES
Corrected Warp Hole so the battle opponent can be swapped only with another Pokémon belonging to the opponent from the field, Bench, or P.C.
Corrected Tractor so Swampert can move to any available adjacent point before the opposing Pokémon moves onto Swampert's previous point.
Mud Coating no longer stacks between multiple regular Swampert.
Swampert and Mega Swampert can still have their separate Mud Coating effects combine.
Dragon Sphere now checks the Pokémon's effective MP after other MP modifiers and only grants +1 MP when the Pokémon is still MP1.
Fixed Aegislash form changes preventing the player from ending their turn.
🎥 REPLAY FIXES
Improved replay synchronization when using Previous Turn.
Rewinding a replay should no longer cause battles to produce different results and desynchronize the rest of the match.

entries.title: Player profiles, Ranked improvements and additional player-reported fixes.
changes: 👤 PLAYER PROFILES
Added Player Profiles during online duels.
Hover over a player's name on desktop, or tap it on mobile, to view their profile.
Player Profiles can display Favorite Figure, Rank, Rating Points, Ranked Wins, Losses and Draws.
Players can choose to make their account Private.
Private profiles only display the player's username.
Improved Player Profile sizing to remove unnecessary empty space.
⚔️ RANKED HEAD-TO-HEAD STATS
During Ranked matches, opponent profiles now display their Win Rate vs You.
Head-to-head Win Rate only counts completed Ranked matches played between those two accounts.
Draws are included in the total number of head-to-head matches.
💤 RANKED AFK DETECTION
Added inactivity detection to Ranked matches.
If a player performs no activity for 2 minutes during their turn, an Are You Still Here warning appears.
The player then has 60 seconds to confirm they are still present.
Pressing YES completely resets the inactivity timer.
If the countdown reaches 0, the inactive player receives an AFK Loss and their opponent receives the win.
Waiting for the opponent does not count as inactivity.
AFK detection only applies to Ranked matches and does not affect Private Online matches.
🎲 RANDOM TEAM IMPROVEMENTS
Significantly improved Random Team loading performance.
Random Team no longer needs to load the player's entire available figure roster before selecting a team.
This should greatly reduce the long freeze that could occur after pressing Random Team.
📚 MOVE & ABILITY LIBRARY
Added a new Move & Ability Library to the Database.
Moves and Abilities can now be browsed separately from the Figure and Plate Libraries.
Selecting a Move or Ability displays its effect and the figures that have access to it.
Duplicate Moves and Abilities are combined into a single entry.
Improved rarity icon spacing and presentation throughout the library.
🔧 FIGURE PROGRESSION
Continued implementation of Figure Leveling, Wheel Expansion and Chain Levels.
Figure Levels can eventually reach Level 10 and Chain Levels can eventually reach Chain Level 10.
Wheel expansion and wheel redistribution systems have been implemented.
Chain Levels increase eligible Attack damage.
Improved Figure Manager upgrade controls.
Rare Metals and Green Cubes can now be used in adjustable quantities instead of one at a time.
Progression materials are still being introduced gradually and may not yet be obtainable through normal gameplay.
🎥 RANKED REPLAYS
Improved Ranked replay saving.
Replays now save correctly whether the player wins or loses.
Ranked matches ended using Forfeit can now save their replay.
Improved Match History so newly uploaded replays appear correctly.
🐛 PLAYER-REPORTED FIXES
Fixed cases where a player could incorrectly receive a Wait Loss despite still having a legal action available.
Available Plates and other possible actions are now properly considered before determining that a player has no actions remaining.
Fixed Leaf Blade and similar additional-spin Attacks so their original result is preserved correctly.
Fixed Leafeon UX - Blade Tail so its effect can activate correctly when losing against eligible White or Gold Attacks.
Fixed Tapu Fini - Misty Surge movement behavior.
Fixed Avalugg - Ice Breaker being usable more than intended during the same turn.
Fixed the AI using Max Revive when both of its Entry Points were already occupied.
Fixed weather information hover boxes appearing incorrectly stretched the first time they were opened.
🖱️ MENU UI CLEANUP
Removed unnecessary hover boxes from several obvious menu controls.
Settings, Discord, library navigation, Filter, Sort and similar self-explanatory controls no longer display redundant hover descriptions.
Informative tooltips explaining mechanics, restrictions, progression and gameplay rules remain available.
🌐 PRIVATE ONLINE MATCHES
Fixed a menu routing issue where leaving or forfeiting a Private Online match could return the player to the Offline menu.
Private Online matches now return to the appropriate Online and Lobby flow.

entries.title: Figure leveling groundwork and additional player-reported fixes.
changes: ⚙️ FIGURE LEVELING & WHEEL EXPANSION
Development has begun on the backend systems for Figure Leveling and Wheel Expansion.
Figure leveling will eventually allow players to expand selected wheel segments while reducing others.
The materials required to level figures are not currently obtainable, so there is currently no way to level figures.
More details about leveling, materials, and progression will be shared as the system gets closer to release.
🐛 PLAYER-REPORTED FIXES
Fixed an issue where players could incorrectly receive a Wait Loss while still having a legal action available.
Available Plates and other possible actions are now properly considered before determining that a player has no actions remaining.
A Wait Loss should now only occur when the player truly has nothing they can do.
🎮 AI IMPROVEMENTS
Smarter AI ?

entries.title: Match Replays and player-reported gameplay fixes.
changes: 🎬 MATCH REPLAYS
Added Replay support for recent matches. (Starting 0.7.2)
⚔️ GAMEPLAY FIXES
Fixed Empoleon – Diving Entry not working correctly on the opening turn.
Fixed Swords Dance stacking its multiplier multiple times. Spinning Swords Dance repeatedly now still results in a maximum ×2 damage multiplier.
Fixed Dragon Tail effects not resolving correctly when losing against eligible White or Gold Attacks.
Fixed 4-D Drive effects not resolving correctly when losing against eligible White or Gold Attacks.
Fixed Sunsteel Strike not sending the opposing Pokémon to the P.C. when its effect should activate against White or Gold results.
Fixed Abyssal Grip sending the wrong Pokémon to the P.C.
Fixed Heracross – Mud Shot not applying its intended MP −1 effect.
Fixed Avalugg effects incorrectly applying while Avalugg was on the Bench instead of requiring it to be on the field.
Fixed qualifying knockouts sometimes failing to trigger the appropriate Evolution opportunity.
💿 PLATE FIXES
Fixed Eon Flute sometimes being unavailable when an excluded Latias or Latios was a valid target.
Separated Mega Evolution Plates into their own category in the Plate Library filters.
🔄 POSITION-SWAPPING FIXES
Fixed the Volt Switch choice prompt displaying the wrong effect name.
Fixed Volt Switch when switching with a Pokémon from the P.C. The Volt Switch user now correctly goes to the P.C. instead of the Bench.
Fixed Gardevoir – Warp Hole when selecting a Pokémon from the P.C. The Pokémon being replaced now correctly goes to the P.C. instead of the Bench.

entries.title: Mobile improvements, library updates and form fixes.
changes: 🗺️ NEW CONTENT
Added a special new map with its own unique presentation and features.
Added new special options to the Settings menu for additional customization.
🗺️ MAP & VISUAL FIXES
Fixed several effects on the Original Map appearing underneath the board on the opponent's side.
Fixed Plate activation effects and battle wheel animations being hidden beneath the Original Map.
Restored Entry Point and Goal icons to their proper board-level position.
Improved rendering of the Original Map so effects display consistently on both sides of the board.
⚔️ BATTLE FIXES
Fixed White and Gold moves with equal final damage not activating their effects correctly.
Fixed Sacred Fire not correctly burning the battle opponent.
Fixed certain move-effect indicators not displaying correctly in figure previews.
Fixed Pokémon attacking from 2 or more spaces away being affected by opposing Attack effects that should not reach them.
Fixed effects such as Grass Knot incorrectly knocking out a Pokémon attacking from Range 2+.
Fixed Force Remove not properly excluding defeated Pokémon.
Force Remove now activates before knockout-related form changes and prevents those transformations when the Pokémon is being excluded.
Knockouts caused by attacks such as Destiny Bond and Double-Edge can once again trigger appropriate evolution, devolution, or form-change effects.
Pokémon sent specifically to the Bench, P.C., or Excluded by a move do not receive knockout-based form-change protection.
Pokémon now recover from Special Conditions when changing form.
Damage increases and reductions are now applied before Double Chance and similar respin prompts.
If a respin occurs, all applicable damage buffs and reductions are recalculated for the new Attack.
Fixed Mega Ampharos – Homeward Lights failing to properly activate a second time when Mega Evolution ends.
Fixed Alolan Raichu – Cosmic Surfer displaying invalid movement destinations.
Fixed Cosmic Surfer accidentally treating Alolan Raichu itself as part of its Electric Pokémon chain.
Fixed Mawile – Trickery so shifting the wheel is optional as intended.
Trickery now asks the player whether they want to shift the result when it lands.
Fixed Trickery activating when both Pokémon landed Blue Attacks.
Trickery now waits for the opposing Attack's effects to resolve before offering its wheel-shift choice.
Fixed Bergmite – Ice Scramble incorrectly protecting Bergmite itself from being tagged while Frozen.
Fixed Arcanine – Flame Turbine potentially shifting the opponent's wheel repeatedly.
Fixed Eevee UX – Bright Arrow interacting incorrectly with Air Balloon. Air Balloon no longer overrides Eevee UX's 3 MP rule while still providing its pass-over movement effect.
Fixed Shadow Ball so its secondary wheel-spin effect resolves correctly.
Fixed Sweet Scent so Wait is only applied when the forced movement successfully occurs.
Fixed Ultra Burst sometimes activating without transforming Necrozma.
Fixed Destiny Bond incorrectly triggering when a Pokémon was knocked out by being surrounded after effects such as Pheromosa – Call Signal.
Fixed Garchomp – Double Flight allowing repeated additional attacks. It can now grant only one extra attack per attack chain.
Fixed Dragon Tail so winning with Dragon Tail knocks out the opponent normally and sends it to the P.C.
Fixed Dragon Tail so its Bench and Wait effect occurs when Dragon Tail loses, as intended.
Fixed Mega Glalie – Icy Armor potentially creating a phantom knockout or visual desync during online matches.
Updated Regice – Lock-On wording to correctly specify one opposing Pokémon within 2 steps.
Improved handling of effects that state "The battle opponent becomes...".
Effects such as Chandelure's Inferno can now affect the battle opponent even if the move user loses or ties, provided the opposing Attack is White, Gold, or Miss.
"The battle opponent becomes..." effects do not activate against Blue or Purple Attacks.
Improved several battle-effect timing rules involving Attack colors, ties, and passive effects.
When a Pokémon manually changes form through an Ability or Attack, that Pokémon must now be used for the remainder of the turn.
Form changes caused by Plates also commit the player to that Pokémon if they continue acting, but the player may still choose to End Turn.
Abilities that explicitly end the turn after transforming continue to do so normally.
Improved several knockout and form-change interactions.
💿 PLATE FIXES
Fixed Restorer failing to properly recognize Amaura as a Restored Pokémon.
Fixed Winged Sphere failing to allow eligible evolved Bug/Flying Pokémon such as Butterfree to move over opposing non-Flying Pokémon.
Improved Stage 1+ detection for Plate effects.
Sphere Plate effects are now indicated on the Pokémon card of affected Pokémon.
Improved Sphere Plate passive information shown on affected Pokémon cards.
Gold Sphere now correctly recognizes Mega Evolution as an Evolution.
Eligible Mega-Evolved Ground-type Pokémon can now have their White Attacks become Gold during their first battle after entering the field, as intended.
✨ FORM CHANGE PERFORMANCE
Significantly reduced the freeze that could occur when activating Ultra Burst.
Form-changing Plates now search only the relevant Pokémon resources instead of unnecessarily loading the entire figure library.
Added a new Form Attachment system that prepares required Pokémon forms during team and match setup.
Form-changing Abilities and Plates can now use already-loaded form data instead of searching for forms during the duel.
Ultra Necrozma is now prepared before the duel when Ultra Burst is equipped on a compatible team.
Improved form-change loading and performance across multiple Pokémon and Plates.
✨ NEW FORM SYSTEM
Added optional form attachments to Team Builder.
Players can choose whether certain optional forms are available to their Pokémon during battle.
Currently supported optional form choices include Giratina, Keldeo, and Zygarde.
Forms required by a Pokémon's core mechanics, Ability, or Plate are attached automatically when needed.
Automatic form support includes systems such as Aegislash, Necrozma, Kyurem, Shaymin, Primal Groudon, Primal Kyogre, Therian Formes, and Rotom forms.
Optional form selections are saved with the team and persist after restarting the game.
Form changes now use a visible transformation sequence similar to Evolution.
Forward form changes play the Evolution sound.
Returning to a base or lower form plays the Devolution sound.
Form-changing Plates now wait for the visible transformation to finish before returning control to the player.
Improved support for automatic form changes that do not need to be manually selected in Team Builder.
Improved automatic form handling for Pokémon such as Aegislash, Rotom, White Kyurem, Black Kyurem, Necrozma, Primal Groudon, Primal Kyogre, and other automatically-attached forms.
Fixed automatic form detection for Pokémon whose form name appears before the species name, such as Wash Rotom and White Kyurem.
Automatic forms required by Evolutions, Abilities, and Plates are now prepared before battle more consistently.
Improved King's Shield and Aegislash's Shield and Blade Forme switching.
Improved automatic form reversion for Kyurem, Rotom, Necrozma, and other form-changing Pokémon.
Form transformations now consistently use the shared transformation animation and Evolution/Devolution sound system.
🏆 RANKED MATCH FIXES
Improved Ranked stability when a player unexpectedly closes the game or disconnects.
When an opponent disconnects during an active Ranked duel, the match now pauses and gives them 60 seconds to reconnect.
A visible reconnect countdown is displayed to the remaining player.
If the disconnected player does not return, they receive the loss and the connected player receives the win.
Players can now search for and reconnect to an unfinished Ranked match after reopening the game.
Added additional safeguards preventing the player who remained connected from accidentally receiving the loss.
Main Menu and Quit Game are disabled during an active Ranked match; players must explicitly use Forfeit Match.
Fixed opponents leaving after MATCH OVER incorrectly starting another reconnect countdown.
Fixed Ranked matches becoming stuck indefinitely on Finalizing Ranked Result.
Improved protection against disconnect events changing a result that had already been determined.
Improved Ranked matchmaking reliability when many players are searching simultaneously.
Fixed cases where players could receive Too Many Requests while searching for Ranked matches.
Fixed Zoroark's Cross Counter incorrectly knocking out Pokémon that should not be affected.
Fixed Thundurus's ability not correctly preventing opposing Pokémon that MP moved next to it that turn from attacking.
Fixed Eevee's evolution selection becoming stuck after knocking out a Pokémon and triggering an evolution choice.
📈 RANKED RATING
Ranked wins now award a minimum of +20 RP.
Ranked losses now remove a maximum of 15 RP.
Draws now always result in 0 RP gained or lost.
Elo/rating difference calculations are still used whenever they produce values within those limits.
👤 RANKED PLAYER INFORMATION
Recent Ranked Matches now show the opponent's Rank Points.
Hovering a recent opponent now displays their player profile.
Player profiles include useful Ranked information such as rank, rating, W/L/D, and favorite Pokémon.
Opponent Rank Points are now displayed underneath their username during Ranked battles.
Online turn indicators and Plate passive displays now use player usernames instead of Player 1 / Player 2.
Online turn indicators now display YOUR TURN and OPPONENT'S TURN where appropriate.
Offline matches continue using Player 1 / Player 2.
🌐 ONLINE & MATCH IMPROVEMENTS
The Duel Complete screen now displays the reason the duel ended.
Added clearer match-end messages for Goal wins, Time Loss, Wait Loss, forfeits, disconnects, lost connections, match dodges, players leaving the match, and Turn Limit results.
🤖 AI IMPROVEMENTS
Improved AI decision-making during battles.
Added additional checks for Pokémon abilities and movement effects when evaluating threats and defensive positions.
Restored the faster AI turn pacing used in earlier versions of the game.
Optimized rush-team and pass-through Ability evaluation so complex movement checks no longer unnecessarily slow down AI turns.
The AI still accounts for important movement Abilities and defensive matchups without repeatedly recalculating them during every simulated path.
Improved AI responsiveness during Offline matches.
The AI now avoids choosing an optional respin when its current Attack is already winning.
If the AI is losing or tied, it may still choose to respin when appropriate.
The AI also avoids voluntarily forcing an unnecessary respin when doing so would give up an already-winning result.
🎮 UI & QUALITY OF LIFE
Added an EXCLUDED viewer above Ultra Space.
Excluded Pokémon are displayed as their actual figures, similar to Ultra Space.
The Excluded viewer safely handles matches where no Pokémon have been excluded.
Hovering Pokémon in the Team Builder now displays their full Pokémon card.
Added a visual FORM option to compatible Pokémon in Team Builder.
Optional forms are displayed using visual cards with the Pokémon's figure, name, rarity, MP, and Attach / Remove option.
Hovering an optional form displays its full Pokémon information card.
Hovering attached Evolution or Form options underneath a selected Pokémon displays the corresponding Pokémon card.
When a YES/NO prompt would evolve, devolve, or change a Pokémon's form, hovering YES now previews the Pokémon it will become.
Pokémon card previews now appear on the opposite side of form and transformation prompts so they do not cover the player's choice.
Pokémon forms are now visible in the Figure Library, even when they cannot be directly added to a team.
Battle-only and automatic forms can now be viewed in Team Builder.
Forms that cannot be selected as one of the six team figures are clearly marked as unavailable for direct addition.
Forms automatically granted by a Plate now indicate which Plate is required.
Automatic form information tooltips are kept inside the screen so they remain readable near the edges of the viewport.
When the required Plate is equipped, its associated form is displayed in that Pokémon's FORM viewer.
Plate-granted forms are shown as automatic and locked attachments and cannot be manually removed.
Removing the required Plate removes its automatic form attachment.
Intrinsic forms such as Aegislash's Shield and Blade Formes are always available in its form viewer.
Optional forms such as Giratina, Keldeo, and Zygarde continue using their normal Attach / Remove controls.
Improved Pokémon form previews and hover-card information throughout Team Builder.
Added a Fullscreen option for desktop players.
Added Streamer Mode to Settings, which hides the team name while searching in online matchmaking.
Fixed excessive empty spacing in the Plate Library preview panel.
Improved several Pokémon card hover displays and information panels.
Various additional UI improvements and fixes based on recently reported issues.
📱 MOBILE IMPROVEMENTS
Reworked Pokémon card interaction for touchscreen devices.
Tapping a Pokémon on mobile now performs the normal gameplay action with a single tap while also opening its Pokémon card for inspection.
Pokémon cards remain open while interacting with them instead of behaving like desktop hover cards.
Players can now touch and drag directly on a Pokémon card to scroll through its information.
Dragging upward on the card scrolls downward through its contents, with normal touch-style scrolling behavior.
Touching or scrolling inside the Pokémon card no longer closes it or activates the board underneath it.
Tapping another Pokémon switches the displayed Pokémon card.
Tapping outside the Pokémon card closes it.
Restored the Pokémon card to its familiar battle-screen position on mobile.
Mobile card sizing adapts when necessary for smaller displays.
Desktop Pokémon card hover behavior remains unchanged.
Added the same touchscreen behavior in preparation for future iOS support.
🍎 macOS IMPROVEMENTS
Improved scrolling support for macOS trackpads.
Added two-finger trackpad scrolling support to several scrollable menus and Pokémon information cards.
Cleaned up a Figure Library 3D viewer camera warning that could appear when opening a model preview.
🩺 STATUS & MARKER INFORMATION
Pokémon cards now show active Special Conditions and markers.
Hovering an affected Pokémon now explains what its current conditions actually do.
Added information for Burn, Poison, Noxious, Paralysis, Sleep, Frozen, and Confusion.
Added information for numerous gameplay markers and temporary effects.
Countdown-based effects display their remaining duration directly on the Pokémon card.
Status and marker information updates while the card remains open.
👤 ACCOUNT IMPROVEMENTS
Users can now log in using their email address instead of only their username.
Users can now change their username.
Usernames now support special characters.
🎵 AUDIO & SETTINGS
Reworked the menu music selector to behave more consistently on Android.
The menu music dropdown now uses the same custom dropdown style as the in-battle selector.
Fixed an Android crash when changing the menu music.
Improved Android handling when switching between Pokémon Duel Remake and Original menu music.
Improved consistency between the Settings menu and battle Settings UI.
📱 ANDROID UPDATE STABILITY
Improved Android stability while downloading game updates.
Reduced conflicting background network activity while update packages are being downloaded or verified.
Prevented additional update checks from interfering with an update already in progress.
🐛 ADDITIONAL FIXES
Fixed several UI elements remaining active or displaying incorrect information after Ranked matches.
Improved handling of form changes, knockout replacements, movement abilities, and Plate effects.
Improved automatic form preparation for Pokémon that evolve or transform after the duel has already started.
Improved handling of form changes triggered by Abilities, Attacks, Plates, Evolutions, and automatic transformations.
Improved several interactions between form changes and turn-action restrictions.
Improved touch input handling so Pokémon information can be viewed without interfering with normal battle controls.
Various additional stability, bug fixes, and interface improvements based on player reports.
